#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pathlib import Path
import math,json
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def make(name,mode,nr=24,nt=4,np_=24,end=.1,start=0,realcfg=None,latmax=30,radial_grid='log'):
 out=HERE/'cases'/name;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 vals=dict(ct_mode=mode,nr=nr,ntheta=nt,nphi=np_,rmin_au=.1,rmax_au=2.4,gamma=1.5,thermal_pressure_factor=2,speed_kms=400,density_1au_cm3=5,br_1au_nt=3,temperature_K=179122.2244731544,map_rotation_rad_day=0 if mode in ['radial','uniform'] else .7,source_surface_au=0,start_day=start,end_day=end,output_dir=out,ct_manufactured_frequency_rad_day=2*math.pi/.7)
 if realcfg:
  parent=dict(line.split('=',1) for line in Path(realcfg).read_text().splitlines() if '=' in line)
  allowed={'rmin_au','rmax_au','gamma','thermal_pressure_factor','speed_kms','density_1au_cm3','br_1au_nt','temperature_K','boundary_map_csv','boundary_csv','map_rotation_rad_day','map_epoch_day','map_longitude_offset_rad','boundary_speed_offset_kms','density_scale','magnetic_scale','temperature_scale','boundary_speed_thermo_closure','boundary_n_v2_cm3_kms2','boundary_T_over_v2_K_per_kms2'}
  vals.update({k:v for k,v in parent.items() if k in allowed})
  (out/'parent_config_reference.cfg').write_text(Path(realcfg).read_text())
  (out/'ignored_parent_config.json').write_text(json.dumps({'reason':'These parent numerical/output flags are inactive in the independent Athena CT control; actual settings are in canonical run.cfg and athinput.ct.','ignored':{k:v for k,v in parent.items() if k not in allowed}},indent=2)+'\n')
 vals.update(ct_mode=mode,nr=nr,ntheta=nt,nphi=np_,start_day=start,end_day=end,output_dir=out,probes_csv='',latmax_deg=latmax,radial_grid=radial_grid,cfl=.25,order=2,threads=1,radial_cell_centers='Athena_volume_weighted',source_surface_au=0)
 vals['x1rat']=(float(vals['rmax_au'])/float(vals['rmin_au']))**(1/nr) if radial_grid=='log' else 1
 (out/'run.cfg').write_text(''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k,v in vals.items()))
 rmin=float(vals['rmin_au']);rmax=float(vals['rmax_au']);gamma=float(vals['gamma']);GM=0 if mode=='uniform' else .0002959122082855911
 text=f'''<job>
problem_id = X3I-CT
<time>
start_time = {start}
tlim = {end}
nlim = -1
cfl_number = .25
integrator = rk2
xorder = 2
ncycle_out = 100
<mesh>
nx1 = {nr}
x1min = {rmin}
x1max = {rmax}
x1rat = {vals['x1rat']}
ix1_bc = user
ox1_bc = {'user' if mode in ['uniform','radial'] else 'outflow'}
nx2 = {nt}
x2min = {math.pi/2-math.radians(latmax)}
x2max = {math.pi/2+math.radians(latmax)}
ix2_bc = user
ox2_bc = user
nx3 = {np_}
x3min = 0
x3max = {2*math.pi}
ix3_bc = periodic
ox3_bc = periodic
num_threads = 1
<meshblock>
nx1 = {nr}
nx2 = {nt}
nx3 = {np_}
<hydro>
gamma = {gamma}
dfloor = 1e-20
pfloor = 1e-20
<problem>
GM = {GM}
config_file = {out/'run.cfg'}
output_dir = {out}
'''
 (out/'athinput.ct').write_text(text);return out
if __name__=='__main__':
 for mode in ['uniform','radial']:
  for n in [24,48]:make(f'{mode}{n}',mode,n,n//6,n)
 make('manufactured48','manufactured',48,8,48,.2)
"}
